scope: Canonical deployed function contracts with mocked authentication/database/storage. Actual runtime guards are separately tested; this suite is not live integration.

results.name: Admin username cannot become a PostgREST OR filter or LIKE wildcard
Admin login does not report success when session persistence fails
Even a pending upload requires the matching receipt
Finalize rejects mismatched storage size/MIME and only accepts matching metadata
Feed pagination advances over scanned rows even when some cannot be emitted
